name: Revival
overview: Scripture reveals revival as a divine restoration of the soul and spirit through God's perfect law and renewing power. The psalmists plead for God to turn His people back to Himself, to create clean hearts, and to revive their spirits so they may rejoice and be saved. Isaiah emphasizes that God dwells with the contrite and humble, reviving their hearts and spirits, highlighting revival as a gracious work of God renewing both individuals and communities in heartfelt repentance and worship.
